# Cmod A7-35T + TinyVGA without TM1638, PLL or MMCM

Select **cmod_a7_35 → cmod_a7_35_tiny_vga_no_pll_no_tm1638_codex** in the board menu. Target: **xc7a35tcpg236-1**; hardware device: **xc7a35t_0**.

TinyVGA hardware: [mole99/tiny-vga](https://github.com/mole99/tiny-vga). [Retail and JLCPCB ordering](../cmod_a7_35_tiny_vga_codex/assembly_en.html#tiny-vga-ordering).

## Lab inputs, LEDs and reset

| Lab signal | Cmod hardware |
| --- | --- |
| key[0] | BTN0, active high when pressed |
| key[1] | BTN1, active high when pressed |
| led[0] | Onboard LED0, active high |
| led[1] | Onboard LED1, active high |

The lab receives **w_key=2 and w_led=2**. Both buttons have two-register synchronizers; the lab can add mechanical debounce if needed. Neither button resets the design. Reset starts asserted at FPGA configuration and releases after three system-clock edges, after MMCM lock where applicable. MMCM lock loss also asserts reset. Restart by reprogramming or cycling board power. The RGB LED remains a reset/running indicator.

There is **no seven-segment display** and no TM1638 controller, even when a lab enables TM1638 or concatenation macros. The lab's segment and digit outputs are unconnected. An internal **w_digit=8** compatibility parameter keeps existing exercises with digit-sized casts and slices legal; it does not create external display hardware. Display-only exercises have no visible digit output. The existing eight-bit switch interface mirrors BTN0/BTN1 on **sw[1:0]**, with **sw[7:2]=0**; these are momentary inputs. Exercises requiring more than two independent controls need adaptation.

## Wiring and clock

Omit the TM1638 module and all five of its wires. **Leave DIP 26–28 unconnected**: the top level has no pio26/pio27/pio28 ports, and their original master-XDC lines remain commented. The remaining **32 scalar ports** retain their original constraints. The XDC differs from the preserved Digilent master only by uncommenting used definitions.

TinyVGA remains on Pmod. INMP441 stays on DIP 29–31 and the DAC on DIP 32–34. Keep the microphone's regulated 3.3 V rail when using it. DAC supply wiring and MCLK-to-GND connection, USB-UART and GPIO 1–8 are unchanged. The shared drawings show the TM1638-equipped assembly; omit its branch. Full instructions: [English](../cmod_a7_35_tiny_vga_codex/assembly_en.html#no-tm1638) · [Русский](../cmod_a7_35_tiny_vga_codex/assembly_ru.html#no-tm1638).

The onboard 12 MHz clock passes through one BUFG. There are no PLL/MMCM cells. TinyVGA supplies **305×480 at 59.835453 Hz**; horizontal timing is 305/8/46/23 cycles and vertical timing is 480/10/2/33 lines, with negative syncs. This is a custom mode with reduced horizontal detail; monitor acceptance needs a physical check. DAC BCK/LRCK are 3 MHz / 46.875 kHz; microphone SCK/WS are 750 kHz / 11.71875 kHz. The DAC still uses its internal PLL. See the [no-PLL timing notes](../cmod_a7_35_tiny_vga_no_pll_codex/README.md).

The top-level source includes the shared wrapper with **CMOD_A7_NO_TM1638** and **CMOD_A7_NO_PLL**. The other two configurations retain TM1638 and their existing BTN0 reset behavior.

## Build and verification

From a lab directory, run `./06_choose_another_fpga_board.bash`, choose the configuration above, then run `./03_synthesize_for_fpga.bash`. The normal synthesis script also programs the FPGA.

To build without programming, use a separate empty output directory with Vivado on PATH:

```bash
vivado -mode batch -source /path/to/basics-graphics-music/scripts/tests/build_cmod_a7_35_tiny_vga_codex.tcl \
    -tclargs labs/2_graphics/2_1_rectangle_ellipse_parabola cmod_a7_35_tiny_vga_no_pll_no_tm1638_codex
```

The driver checks the absence of TM1638 pins/controller cells and PLL/MMCM cells, reports clocks, utilization, DRC and timing, then writes **cmod_a7_35_tiny_vga_no_pll_no_tm1638_codex.bit** after constrained setup/hold timing passes. External I/O delays are unspecified in the inherited XDC. Hardware and monitor testing remain outstanding.

From the repository root, `python3 scripts/tests/test_cmod_a7_35_tiny_vga_codex.py` checks all four configurations, including independent/simultaneous button presses, LED mapping, reset, a complete video frame, microphone data and I²S audio. No-TM1638 simulations exclude the controller source so accidental instantiation fails. `python3 scripts/tests/test_board_menu.py` checks selection and Vivado dispatch.

Vivado 2026.1 validation on 17 November 2026 built the rectangle/ellipse/parabola example through bitstream generation: **setup WNS +78.257 ns, hold WHS +0.151 ns**, 213 LUTs and 48 registers. The routed design uses one BUFG and zero PLL/MMCM cells and has no TM1638 controller. DRC reports zero errors; the inherited CFGBVS-1 warning remains. There are no unclocked registers or unconstrained internal endpoints. External I/O delays remain unspecified. Eight board regression tests and all 22 menu tests passed; both shared HTML guides passed desktop/mobile checks. No physical hardware was programmed or tested.

## Кратко по-русски

В меню выберите **cmod_a7_35 → cmod_a7_35_tiny_vga_no_pll_no_tm1638_codex**. TM1638 отсутствует; DIP 26–28 оставьте свободными. Две кнопки Cmod подключены к **key[1:0]**, два светодиода — к **led[1:0]**; BTN0 соответствует биту 0, BTN1 — биту 1. Ни одна кнопка не вызывает сброс. Для перезапуска повторно запрограммируйте FPGA или выключите и включите питание. Семисегментного индикатора нет: выходы индикатора работы неподключены. Параметр w_digit=8 сохраняет совместимость существующих работ. sw[1:0] дублирует кнопки, sw[7:2]=0. Вся логика работает на 12 МГц через один BUFG, без PLL/MMCM. TinyVGA выдаёт 305×480 при 59,835453 Гц; горизонтальное разрешение уменьшено. ЦАП: BCK 3 МГц, LRCK 46,875 кГц; INMP441: SCK 750 кГц, WS 11,71875 кГц. Внутренняя PLL ЦАП используется.

Подключение TinyVGA, микрофона и ЦАП описано в [русской инструкции](../cmod_a7_35_tiny_vga_codex/assembly_ru.html#no-tm1638); исключите ветвь TM1638 на рисунках. Приведённая команда Vivado создаёт битовый файл без программирования платы.
